name: degraded
description: The Git server of samm-assessments is unreachable: reads come from the last fetch, saves fail.

items.title: INC-0007 card data exposure: notification to the authority
Risk R-012: supplier access to production

unreachable.description: The fetch of samm-assessments and of threat-models fails: the status lists both as DOWN, the reads of the threat models are served from the last fetch, and every write of the threat models answers 503 GIT_UNAVAILABLE.

recovered.description: The Git server is reachable again.
